onboarding_welcomeDescription: Start sketching, or bring in a design you'd like to trace over. No setup needed.
onboarding_imageSourcesOptional: optional — enables real images in designs
onboarding_imageSourcesDescription: Add any of these keys to enable real images. Claude picks the best source for each image automatically.
onboarding_privacyNote: Keys are stored locally in your browser. They are never sent to our servers — API calls go directly to Anthropic and Google.
onboarding_welcomeModalDescription: Your AI-powered design companion. Describe what you want, and watch as beautiful concepts come to life on your canvas.
onboarding_featureDesignAi: Design with AI — Generate beautiful HTML/CSS concepts from natural language
onboarding_featureCompare: Compare variations — See up to 4 different designs side by side
onboarding_featureExport: Export anywhere — Copy code or save as images
tour_step1Desc: Type any design — a landing page, Instagram ad, app screen. Be specific about colors, style, and content.
tour_step2Desc: Hit Enter or click Generate. Calca creates multiple variations, each one learning from the last.
tour_step3Desc: Each frame is a polished HTML/CSS design. Pan and zoom the canvas to explore.
tour_step4Desc: Want a different take? Remix any frame with a new direction.
tour_step5Desc: Click anywhere on a design to leave feedback. Calca will revise just that part.
tour_step6Desc: Export to Figma, Tailwind CSS, or React components.
tour_waitingMessage: Generate your first design to continue the tour
tour_promptBarContent: This is the prompt bar. Type your design idea here and press Enter or click the arrow to generate.
tour_toolbarContent: Use the toolbar to adjust settings, view variations, and export your designs.
tour_providerContent: Select your AI provider from the dropdown. If you don't see any providers, you'll need to add one first.
tour_addProviderContent: Click here to add a new AI provider. You'll need to provide the provider's base URL and API key.
tour_unsplashContent: Add your Unsplash API key here to enable image generation in your designs.
tour_allSetContent: You can restart this tour anytime from Settings → General.
canvas_emptyDescription: Nothing here yet. Start a new project, or import something to trace over.
dialog_resetDescription: This will clear your current canvas. Generated designs will be lost.
banner_addApiKey: Add your API key in Settings to start designing
modesidebar_systemPromptPlaceholder:
Add custom instructions for the AI designer...

e.g. "You are a Facebook ad designer. Use 1200x628, minimal text, strong visual hierarchy..."
modesidebar_systemPromptDescription: Prepended to every generation. Use for brand guidelines, design skills, or style overrides.
settings_dialogDescription: Configure your Calca preferences including AI provider, theme, and personalization options.
settings_providerIdHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
settings_apiKeysDescription: Add API keys to enable AI design generation and image sources.
settings_analyticsDescription: Help us improve Calca by sharing anonymous usage patterns. No prompts or designs are ever shared.
settings_tutorialDescription: Take the tutorial again to learn about Calca's features.
settings_resetDescription: Clear all settings, canvas data, and preferences. This action cannot be undone.
settings_resetEverythingDescription: This will permanently delete all your settings, canvas designs, API keys, and preferences.
settings_resetConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete all your settings, canvas designs, API keys, and preferences. The app will reload with default settings.
settings_aboutTagline: AI design tool for the web
settings_errorApiKeyTooShort: API key must be at least 10 characters
settings_errorModelUnavailable: Selected model is not available for this provider
feedback_buttonLabel: Report a bug or share feedback
feedback_dialogDescription: Report a bug, request a feature, or share general feedback.
feedback_subtitle: Help us improve Calca by sharing your thoughts.
feedback_successDescription: Your feedback has been posted to the discussion.
feedback_rateLimitedDescription: You've submitted too many reports. Please try again later.
feedback_errorTitleTooLong: Title must be {max} characters or less
feedback_errorDescriptionTooLong: Description must be {max} characters or less
feedback_errorEmailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
feedback_errorEmailDisposable: Disposable email addresses are not allowed
feedback_errorRateSessionMax: Maximum submissions reached for this session. Please refresh the page to submit more.
feedback_errorRateDailyMax: Daily submission limit reached. Please try again tomorrow.
feedback_errorRateSpam: Too many submissions detected. Please wait 30 minutes before trying again.

design.errorNoFrameResult: No frame result received from workflow

promptbar_visionWarning: This model may not support image input
promptbar_critiqueToggleDesc: Sequential frames with AI review between each. Slower and uses more tokens.
promptbar_fastModeDesc: Compact semantic-token HTML. Optimized for weak and free models — cheap and dependable.
promptbar_detailedModeDesc: Richer Tailwind layouts with a disciplined semantic palette. Best for capable models.
promptbar_variationsTooltip: Number of design variations to generate
promptlib_toastText: A set of toast notification components — success, error, warning, and info variants. Stacked layout with icons, message text, and dismiss buttons. Rounded corners, subtle shadows.
promptlib_pricingCardsText: Three pricing tier cards side by side — Starter, Pro, Enterprise. Each with feature list, price, and CTA button. The middle card should be highlighted as the recommended option.
promptlib_loginFormText: A modern login form with email and password fields, 'Remember me' checkbox, forgot password link, and a primary sign-in button. Include social login options (Google, GitHub).
promptlib_settingsPanelText: An account settings panel with profile section (avatar, name, email), notification toggles, theme selector (light/dark), and a danger zone with delete account button.
promptlib_navBarText: A responsive top navigation bar with logo, nav links (Home, Features, Pricing, Docs), search input, and a user avatar dropdown. Clean and minimal.
promptlib_modalDialogText: A confirmation modal dialog with a warning icon, title, description text, and two action buttons (Cancel and Confirm). Semi-transparent backdrop overlay.
promptlib_heroSectionText: A SaaS landing page hero section with a large headline, subheadline, email capture input with CTA button, and a product screenshot or abstract illustration area below. Trust badges at the bottom.
promptlib_dashboardText: An analytics dashboard with a sidebar nav, top stats row (4 metric cards), a large area chart, and a recent activity table below. Dark or light theme, clean data visualization.
promptlib_pricingPageText: A full pricing page with a toggle for monthly/annual billing, three plan cards with feature comparison lists, an FAQ section below, and an enterprise CTA banner.
promptlib_blogPostText: A blog post page with article title, author avatar and byline, publish date, featured image, body text with headings and paragraphs, and a related posts section at the bottom.
promptlib_socialCardText: A social media announcement card (1200x630 ratio) for a product launch. Bold headline, product name, a brief tagline, and a gradient or solid color background. Eye-catching and shareable.
promptlib_emailHeaderText: An email header/hero section for a product newsletter. Company logo, bold announcement headline, short description, and a prominent CTA button. Works at 600px width.
promptlib_bannerAdText: A web banner ad (728x90 leaderboard format) for a SaaS product. Product name, value proposition in one line, and a 'Try Free' CTA button. Clean, not cluttered.
promptlib_featureSectionText: A product feature section with three columns. Each column has an icon, feature title, and short description. Clean grid layout with consistent spacing. Include a section headline above.
